messages:
sam: Heads-up: support reports spike in fallbacks after the header canonicalization rollout. lots of v1 clients getting routed to v2 shim.
nana: digging into logs. many SDKs send X-Client-Version: v1.0 vs v1 and our new normalizer maps them differently. scorer returns low compatibility.
michael: we intended canonicalization to reduce noise. sounds like we missed an OR-match on raw vs normalized headers.
tara: short-term mitigation: add 'lenient' compatibility mode that accepts both variants, and a per-tenant flag so we can opt-in conservative customers.
leah: ops wants a preview before flipping modes. can we add a /api/rollouts/preview endpoint that simulates strict vs lenient using the last 5m of headers? need token-cost delta + expected fallback_rate.
michael: yes. I'll add POST /api/rollouts/preview {tenant, mode, window_seconds} -> returns simulated rates and quota impact. tag preview traces so they don't affect alerts.
sam: also add a console toggle: Strict | Lenient | Shadow. Shadow emits shadow traces but keeps routing unchanged. ops will use shadow for 24h on customers before applying lenient.
nana: UX copy: "Lenient accepts minor header variants to avoid false positives during staged deprecations." will add a preview card showing current vs strict vs lenient columns.
leah: ops-bot: scheduled dry-run: cohort=10% starting 02:00 UTC, will monitor compat.fallback_rate and latency.p95 for 60m.
ops-bot: dry-run job created and monitoring metrics: compat.fallback_rate, latency.p95, preview.quota_delta.
michael: follow-ups: ana -> quick scorer OR-match patch + unit tests; me -> preview endpoint + trace tagging; nana -> UI preview card; sam -> coordinate support notices for affected tenants.
sam: thumbs-up. if preview looks good we can promote lenient to beta cohort and then widen. keep alert channel posted.
nana: adding tooltip draft: "Preview estimates how many requests would route to the fallback under each compatibility mode and the expected token-cost delta."
michael: will return preview payload within 10m.
sam: thanks team. reconvene after 30m for metric check.
